description: Everything about ONE product's prices in one call: its own price, old price and currency; the price-list rows (other currencies); per-channel price overrides (platform, currency, price); wholesale quantity breaks per currency; the purchase cost with its currency (a bundle's cost is derived from its components and cannot be set on it); and the markup over cost per sale currency (marginPercent = price ÷ cost − 1, in percent; not a margin on the price) — the cost crossed at the workspace's stated rate, null with missingRate true when no rate is stated. Read-only. Use search_products for the id; call it before set_product_channel_price, set_product_price_tiers or upsert_product_prices so you change the right row, and after a change to confirm it. For a whole group of products use preview_bulk_price_change.

id.description: The product id returned by search_products or get_product — never a SKU or a name.
